resources.string: Log a dose of your four usual medications with one tap.
Type to filter by note content
Each mark is a logged dose, not a goal.
Log the dose when you take it
PillMate is for as-needed medication: the kind you take when you need it. There are no schedules to keep and no alarms chasing you.
One tap is enough. Also from the widget and from the notification, without opening the app.
Each dot is a dose, placed at its time and in the colour of its medication. 00 is at the top and it turns like a normal clock.
Try it: tap a dot to see what it was.
With more days, your pattern shows up
Put several days together and the dots turn into bars: the longer the bar, the more doses at that hour. PillMate works out your most active hour and how often you usually take a dose.
It describes, it doesn\'t judge: no scores, no goals and no medical advice.
What you log never leaves your phone
No accounts, no ads and no analytics. Your data is yours and stays with you.
The app has no network permission: it can\'t send anything.
